description.value: Farm Country Brewing is a Langley craft brewery producing a wide roster of beers from German Pilsners and hazy IPAs to fruit sours and stouts, served in a plaza tasting room with a full food menu built around locally-sourced ingredients. The space hosts regular live music, open-mic nights, and themed trivia evenings, giving it a lively community-hub feel. Cyclists in the Fraser Valley corridor will find a solid sit-down meal and a rotating selection of house-brewed beer within a short detour of the Langley Central transit hub.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 41m; bollard (2 spaces) at 79m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active craft brewery tasting room with a full food menu and regular events through mid-2026. The menu subpage uses [V] and [GF] tags on specific dishes confirming vegetarian and gluten-free options, and the homepage 'ORDER NOW' / delivery copy plus the online beer shop confirm takeout availability. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site or in the OSM tags.
concerns: OSM address is missing unit number (#5) and postal code; website shows full address as 20555 56 Ave #5, Langley, BC V3A 3Y9 — used website value.
Phone number (778) 819-2288 is present on website but absent from OSM tags; added from website.
OSM opening_hours differ slightly from website hours (e.g. OSM lists Mon 12:00–20:00; website lists Mon 2 pm–8 pm) — minor discrepancy worth correcting in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active craft brewery tasting room with a full food menu, confirmed open with upcoming events in May–June 2026; a useful food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists in the Langley area.
